factsToCheck: Unit and node wording to be checked against the Political Science and International Relations optional syllabus in the current UPSC Civil Services (Main) Examination notification, English and Hindi versions

Paper 1 is 'Political Theory and Indian Politics' (Section A: Political Theory and Indian Politics; Section B: Indian Government and Politics); Paper 2 is 'Comparative Politics and International Relations' (Section A: Comparative Political Analysis and International Politics; Section B: India and the World)
Section B of Paper 1 in the notification numbers its items 1 to 11; 'Principal Organs' appears as items (a) Union and (b) State: here merged into one unit
Spelling 'Dharamshastra' and 'Rawl's' follows the notification as remembered; here 'Rawls'' is used: check
Paper 2 Section B item 3(c) wording 'India's "Look East" policy' as in the notification (the government later used the name Act East): check whether the notification has been updated
Hindi unit and node titles follow common UPSC Hindi syllabus terms (उपागम, प्राधान्य for hegemony, सकारात्मक कार्रवाई for affirmative action): check against the official Hindi syllabus
Node counts: Paper 1 has 67 nodes, Paper 2 has 43 nodes, each planned at 1 to 3 study hours
